focus: Nonredundant hybrids: compositional blindness, countermodel-based premise audits, and identifiable mechanism interactions

scope.source_baseline: 8050c66900899771766f33e8f5fdd200b7dd9120 plus the in-progress dag audit and research_01 through research_09
scope.seed_access: Did not read seed_prompt.txt, any answer key, its path, private storage, or any paid-model output. Only FOUNDATIONS.md, EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md, research_01..09, selected source code, and composition_catalog.json metadata were inspected. No task-specific answer or derived seed formula is included.
scope.novelty_claim: Adaptations to this repository, not literature-wide inventions. Information-flow control, bounded countermodel search, and factorial experiments are established methods. Each idea identifies its nearest prior report and the additional mechanism or estimand.
scope.implementation_boundary: The information-flow compiler, premise encoder/replayer, and factorial assignment contract below are proposals. Native port checks, lineage taint, exact rational arithmetic, and existing selection code do not implement them or certify graduate-QM reasoning.
scope.benchmark_isolation: Every model stage receives the identical original UTF-8 seed as a separate immutable message, with request assembly checked for actual byte inclusion as well as seed and request hashes. Wrappers and audit artifacts are separate. No stage has repository retrieval, shell, filesystem, private-evaluator, or answer-key tools. Private scoring occurs only after final output is frozen and never returns to workflow stages.
scope.catalog_boundary: At inspection the catalog metadata recorded nine reports and 3836 candidates in a finite ordered-macro slice. Its exclusions explicitly omit general multi-input/campaign operations and implicit fan-out. Adding this report does not update that count or make the enumeration exhaustive. Proposed single-consumer packet chains require concrete product schemas, exact native port contracts and a broker implementation before lowering.
scope.external_envelope: A partially applied workflow with every policy/checker/control bundle frozen can expose RunContext -> Outcome. The uninstantiated mechanisms do not have that type: I01 requires VisibilityContract and SyntheticLeakPanel; I02 requires PublicPremiseTheory and ReferenceReplay; I03 requires a campaign-generated FactorialAssignment and frozen FactorialProtocol. These may be explicitly bundled into an extended RunContext but cannot be manufactured from a prior Outcome. Native compilation must retain every unsatisfied external input.

primary_sources.title: Sabelfeld and Myers, Language-Based Information-Flow Security, IEEE JSAC 2003
primary_sources.relevance: Source for language-level information-flow policies and security typing. We adapt the distinction between access permission and downstream propagation to preservation of experimentally blind stages; this is a proposed application, not a proven security implementation.

primary_sources.title: Alloy Language Reference, official Alloy distribution
primary_sources.relevance: Defines assertion counterexamples relative to model facts and finite analysis scope. Motivates explicit premise satisfiability and bounded countermodel receipts; failure to find a finite counterexample is not an unrestricted theorem.

primary_sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH Engineering Statistics Handbook, 5.4.3 How to model DOE data
primary_sources.relevance: Full factorial designs distinguish main effects and interactions, while fractional designs need alias assumptions. Motivates a full two-factor experiment rather than attributing a hybrid's performance to each named subsystem.

repository_evidence.observation: Separates declared witness checking, finite detector tests, metric-relative selection, typed substitution, and intended semantic adequacy. None supplies an end-to-end graduate-QM checker.
Preserves the exact seed, excludes the private evaluator from all online stages, requires repeated same-item comparisons and one complete-run USD 0.10 ledger.

Metadata has nine research reports; only a declared finite grammar is enumerated. External campaign/control inputs and general fan-out are excluded; blind stages and shared reservations must survive composition.
Repair rules are host-authored because raw judge text may contain answers. Missing checkers and checker disagreements are infrastructure/checker failures rather than positive evidence.

LineageTaintEngineV1 propagates marked ancestry in one pass over supplied edges. Unsorted edges can require another pass; it is not a general transitive information-flow analysis and tracks no control dependence.
Inheritance edges require a sealed witness naming parent and child and reject cycles. A lineage seal does not prove absence of unrecorded prompt/context channels.
The mutation service applies edits with protected spans and rechecks exact bytes. Its content-addressed child can record wrapper variants without changing the seed.

Clean-panel screening does not admit a detector. evaluate_rule activates a probe to avoid vacuous success from an inactive matcher. Similar positive and negative controls are needed for leakage and premise detectors.
The independent-signal entry point checks explicit evidence provenance before conjunction. That interface is not a statistical-independence theorem and cannot repair shared parser errors.
Native port equality includes name, colour, schema reference/digest and validator reference/digest. Human-readable RunContext/Outcome names do not suffice for a bridge.
Agent slices restrict operation and source/target colours, but the method does not examine request bytes, control dependencies, tools, caches, or broker-visible fields.
Compilation accepts a finite single-consumer graph with injected validation, checks source pins and full ordered interface, and explicitly grants no admission or execution authority.
Exact rational input rejects floats/booleans and enforces canonical positive denominators; it can replay bounded rational witnesses but is not a complete symbolic/QM model finder.
Selection requires paired records, provenance and fresh confirmation. Its improvement predicate is not an estimator of a factorial interaction; the latter needs a separately preregistered analysis.

common_budget_policy.formula: For a complete assigned run reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R + C_metered_host + C_paid_evaluation <= USD 0.10 before the first call. Prices are USD/token. Count the unchanged seed, system/schema messages and prior visible artifacts in I_s, and every billable reasoning/output token in O_s. Account for every branch, helper, fallback, cancellation and retry; all proposed runs have at most two model calls, zero automatic retries and zero model fallbacks.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: All examples assume pinned endpoints with p_in <= 0.000001, p_out <= 0.000005, F_s=0, R=USD0.01, zero incremental unmetered host cost and no paid scoring call. I01 reserves USD0.043; I02 and each assigned I03 run reserve USD0.046. These are admission thresholds, not quotations of current prices. Unknown fees or uncapped reasoning cause refusal.
common_budget_policy.fail_closed: Both slots share one durable ledger. Input tokenization, endpoint price semantics and hard output caps must be validated before admission. Timeout/cancellation retains the full uncertain reservation. An overlong request is refused or the run frozen incomplete; never truncate or rewrite the seed. Any paid post-freeze scoring must fit the same cap and call allowance or be refused.
common_budget_policy.host_bounds: I01: at most 64 workflow nodes, 128 edges and 64 synthetic twin-trace probes. I02: at most 8 claims, 8 premises per claim, 256 assignments per explicit finite carrier, 512 AST nodes per claim, 256-bit integer arithmetic. I03: same frozen bounded checker per arm. Each host pass has 2-second CPU and 256-MiB limits; limit exhaustion is OPEN_RESOURCE, never success.
common_budget_policy.campaign: The run cap is not campaign-spend authorization. For I03 each assigned arm is one complete two-call run; a replicated four-arm campaign contains 4N runs and up to 8N calls, needs a separate aggregate budget and randomized fixed-N plan, and is not hidden inside one USD0.10 invocation.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Retain request/seed/response hashes, endpoint/version and price snapshot, reserved and settled costs, all available provider usage fields, wall time, sum of provider durations, refusal/truncation/timeout states and final freeze time. Unavailable fields are unavailable, not zero. Zero actual paid calls were made.

ideas.name: Information-flow certificates that preserve blind stages under composition

mathematical_basis.known_method: Information-flow typing, provenance propagation and relational noninterference tests.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Compile each stage's declared visibility into an origin-set effect alongside its mathematical port type. PFP binds the exact materialized request to a contract; PCIV records wrapper and broker transformations; EIS screens the compiler with benign and deliberately leaking synthetic controls; OPERADS rejects substitutions whose information effects exceed the recipient's allowed view. Demonstrate it on a complete solver followed by a candidate-blind challenge call, while keeping the challenge input independent of the solver output.
mathematical_basis.rule: For a node v, L(v) contains its direct data origins plus all data and control-dependency origins. In a DAG compute the union in topological order, or reach a fixed point. A request for blind role b is allowed only if L(request_b) is a subset of Allowed(b). Candidate presence, candidate-derived IDs/hashes, exception strings, token counts and dispatch decisions are origins too. Merely renaming or hashing a field does not declassify it.
mathematical_basis.relational_obligation: For deterministic request compiler K, synthetic hidden inputs h,h' and identical public p and randomness r, require Observe_b(K(p,h,r)) = Observe_b(K(p,h',r)). Observe includes exact message bytes, tools, model/settings, budget allowance, dispatch flag and routing metadata. Challenges must be scheduled independently of candidate content. Finite twin probes falsify leaks but do not prove noninterference for arbitrary code. Real provider timing/cache channels are outside this bounded claim and recorded as residual.
mathematical_basis.system_bridge: A compiler receipt names the pinned request builder and field-level origin derivation. That receipt is consumed by the broker before dispatch; a separate synthetic mutation panel challenges the same builder, not a textual copy. Lineage-only OR taint is insufficient because wrapper choice can leak via control flow.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R05-I02 proposes candidate-blind challenge generation, and R08-I03 tests fault propagation. This proposal tests whether that blindness survives composition, including implicit channels and a correct-colour but wrong-visibility substitution. It does not claim a new challenge strategy or that two same-model calls have independent errors.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: (RunContext, VisibilityContract, SyntheticLeakPanel, PinnedRequestBuilder) -> OutcomeWithVisibilityReceipt. RunContext -> Outcome is valid only after the three external bundles are independently supplied and frozen; no prior candidate Outcome can supply a clean calibration panel or retroactively authorize visibility.
mathematical_basis.native_lowering: Use a serial product packet with a host-only sealed candidate and separately materialized model views. Passing a host packet down one edge is not permission to serialize all its fields into the model. No implicit native fan-out or coercion from candidate-sealed to candidate-visible ports.

assumptions: The trusted broker has no private answer key, private evaluator route, filesystem/repository retrieval or model conversation history beyond the explicitly constructed messages.
Allowed origin sets, synthetic leak/benign fixtures, observation fields and request-builder source pins are frozen before seeing a candidate.
Host-only sealed artifacts are inaccessible to the model transport adapter; all referenced views have concrete schemas and validators.
Timing, provider caching and underlying model pretraining may correlate attempts; absence of declared data flow does not establish statistical independence.
ideas.hypothesis: On a held-out synthetic composition panel, origin/control-flow enforcement blocks every preregistered candidate-to-blind-role leak while rejecting at most 2% of valid compositions, and catches more leaks than colour-only or data-lineage-only enforcement. The benchmark accuracy effect is measured separately and may be zero.

stages.instruction: Bind external inputs, reserve both calls, preserve the exact seed, and build isolated model views. PrivateEvaluation is not an input type.

Check topological data/control-origin closure and run finite twin probes against the pinned builder. Public synthetic values only; never use real private storage as a leak probe. Any prohibited observed dependency refuses dispatch.

Receive only the unchanged seed and frozen answer instructions. Produce one complete derivation with public claim IDs. The broker stores output in a host-only field and retains both pre-reserved slots.

Receive only the unchanged seed and the preregistered generic challenge grammar. Never receive candidate bytes, length, hashes, checks, confidence or candidate-dependent routing. Emit up to four public predicate tests without producing or endorsing a full task answer. Dispatch remains fixed even if the first response is unusable, except run-wide infrastructure refusal.

Only after both outputs are frozen, apply admissible public tests and annotate the original answer. Do not splice or repair it. Record bounded visibility assurance, unresolved channels and all failures. Trusted private grading is strictly afterward.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: The same two-call solver/challenger schedule with ordinary port-colour checks and the same token caps; host-only synthetic tests compare composition enforcement before any paid benchmark.
ablations: Correct type checks with full-packet serialization enabled in the synthetic harness
Data-flow enforcement without twin-trace compiler probes
Compiler probes without pinned request-builder identity
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Use disjoint public development and confirmation compositions. Leak fixtures include candidate-conditioned wrapper selection, candidate hashes, swallowed-error text and shared-history serialization; benign fixtures carry host-only artifacts without exposing them. Report leaks admitted, benign refusals, OPEN channels and complete-answer score/cost separately. No intentionally leaking paid seed run is required.

ideas.falsification: Any known prohibited origin appearing in an admitted blind request falsifies the contract. A candidate-dependent dispatch choice also falsifies it even when message text is unchanged. Failing the false-refusal threshold or showing no gain over data-only taint falsifies the practical hypothesis; unchanged QM scores do not invalidate a genuine isolation improvement.
risks: Incomplete origin instrumentation or a shared buggy serializer can satisfy both type checks and synthetic probes.
An opaque model/provider can have undeclared cache/history channels beyond the observed broker boundary.
Copying only a candidate hash still breaks strict candidate blindness; cryptographic opacity is not noninterference.
The challenge pattern is inherited from earlier research; the novel contribution is enforceable visibility at composition, not an additional correctness witness.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=12000; O_total<=4200 (3600+600). C_max<=12000*p_in+4200*p_out+sum(F_s)+R+C_metered_host+C_paid_evaluation. Under common conditional assumptions reserve USD0.043. Every later added compiler/helper/judge call consumes the same two-call and USD0.10 limits.

ideas.name: Premise stress tests with replayable finite countermodels

mathematical_basis.known_method: Bounded model finding, antecedent satisfiability checks and countermodels for premise dependence.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Require candidate inference claims to expose a bounded, independently interpretable premise context. The host enumerates a frozen public carrier and separately tests whether the antecedent has any instances, whether the stated implication has a countermodel, and which declared premise omissions admit countermodels. EIS reports distinct vacuity, invalid-inference and dependence findings; PCIV produces a single wrapper patch tied to a replayed witness; OPERADS keeps audit-view hypotheses separate from immutable task premises.
mathematical_basis.finite_queries: For explicit finite Omega and candidate Gamma={a1,...,ak}, Q, let S={w in Omega: all a in Gamma hold}; W0={w in S: not Q(w)}. For each j let Wj={w in Omega: all a_i with i!=j hold, not a_j(w), and not Q(w)}. Nonempty W0 is a checked countermodel to the encoded implication. Empty S is VACUOUS_IN_SCOPE, not proof of global inconsistency. Nonempty Wj demonstrates that dropping a_j permits a failure in this finite interpretation; it does not prove a_j is globally necessary or scientifically causal.
mathematical_basis.countermodel_scope: A valuation over uninterpreted atoms may be unrealizable under the intended mathematics. Such valuations are only abstract dependency diagnostics. A claim-level refutation requires a concrete witness satisfying a separately checked decoder and every original domain constraint. Empty W0 is NO_COUNTERMODEL_IN_SCOPE unless Omega is demonstrably the entire declared finite domain; it never certifies an unbounded analytic statement.
mathematical_basis.system_bridge: PFP's relation is encoded-premises-and-counterexample, checked by independent exact replay. The EIS signal is the replayed failed implication or vacuous scope, not agreement with the solver. PCIV records the public witness class and a protected wrapper edit. OPERADS ports distinguish OriginalTaskContext from AuditContextMinusPremise and forbid substituting the latter for the former.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R01-I01 checks dependency closure; R01-I02 checks formula definedness/branch coverage; R08-I02 challenges extractor distinctions; R05-I02 generates blind tests. This mechanism instead searches for premise inconsistency and relative premise necessity in a fixed finite interpretation, including cases where every listed parent is present but the implication is invalid or vacuous.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: (RunContext, PublicPremiseTheory, FiniteCarrier, ReferenceReplay) -> OutcomeWithPremiseAudit. These theory/decoder inputs must be frozen independently of private scores. A solver-generated premise AST is untrusted input, not authority to define the host theory. Missing interpretation produces OPEN_UNSUPPORTED rather than an invented checker.

assumptions: Only explicit finite relations, bounded Boolean formulas with independently justified interpretation, and bounded exact-rational ASTs are admitted.
Candidate claims remain linked to original seed obligations; audit deletions never modify seed bytes, task assumptions or the final requested scope.
The independent replayer does not reuse the candidate evaluator's parsing/normalization path for every critical operation.
Countermodels or apparent vacuity under abstract/unrealizable interpretations are not passed off as task errors; each receipt carries its interpretation scope.
ideas.hypothesis: Against dependency-closure checking alone, premise stress testing detects more injected vacuous or invalid local implications on an untouched synthetic panel while preserving every supported valid implication; on the frozen seed it reduces unqualified use of extra assumptions without losing more than 3 rubric points at equal total resources.

stages.instruction: Freeze public interpretation, bounds and controls; reserve the two-call envelope and include exact original seed bytes. Refuse a theory bundle derived from private seed labels.

Return a complete answer and at most eight local implication claims with explicit premise ASTs and public-obligation bindings. Do not select or relabel host interpretation rules. Extra assumptions must be identified as extra.

Evaluate S,W0,Wj within the declared carrier, replay selected witnesses independently, and preserve all original task assumptions. Select at most four findings in fixed claim-ID order. A failed realization bridge remains abstract; empty search and resource exhaustion are never correctness.

Receive the unchanged seed, original candidate and only allowlisted public claim IDs, premise IDs, scope labels and witness classes. Correct the original derivation or qualify unresolved local steps; never weaken the task. No private evaluator feedback and no second search/repair cycle.

Apply schema-valid claim patches, recheck changed public implications and dependency receipts, retain the original if patch binding fails, and freeze answer plus all unresolved premise/encoding obligations. Public finite checks remain separate from private mathematical grading.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two-call complete draft plus dependency/context audit and one repair, with identical endpoint, input/output ceilings and checker CPU allowance.
ablations: Shared candidate/replay evaluator instead of separately implemented replay
Abstract Boolean witnesses accepted without realization checks, in synthetic controls only
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Synthetic confirmation families include inconsistent antecedents, an omitted necessary premise, a genuinely redundant premise, a valid implication with no sampled antecedent instance, and unrealizable Boolean countermodels. Report scope-conditioned false refutations, witnessed invalid implications, vacuity findings, premise coverage, original-answer completeness and later trusted rubric score.

ideas.falsification: A purported concrete countermodel that fails an original domain constraint falsifies the replay bridge. Treating an empty sampled antecedent as globally inconsistent, or an empty search as a universal proof, falsifies the reporting contract. No increased detection over closure-only checking, any false refutation of supported valid fixtures, or violation of the preregistered accuracy-loss margin defeats the stated benefit.
risks: An independent finite interpretation may be unavailable for the seed's analytic claims; many results may correctly remain OPEN.
Candidate and replayer may share the same erroneous semantic encoding even when their arithmetic code differs.
A premise needed in one finite carrier need not be globally minimal, and a redundant premise need not be safe to delete from the user's requested formulation.
A patch may repair its abstract encoding while leaving prose wrong; unlinked prose remains unchecked.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=14000; O_total<=4400 (3000+1400). C_max<=14000*p_in+4400*p_out+sum(F_s)+R+C_metered_host+C_paid_evaluation. Under common conditional assumptions reserve USD0.046, with all public searches local and bounded.

ideas.name: Factorial isolation of proof-context and diagnostic-repair synergy

mathematical_basis.known_method: A randomized full 2x2 factorial experiment identifies interactions separately from main effects.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Fix one two-call draft/repair graph. Factor A adds typed premise/dependency context to the draft and host validation. Factor B replaces generic repair instructions with a calibrated, allowlisted public diagnostic packet. PCIV freezes the four wrapper configurations and their ancestry, PFP checks candidate-bound artifacts, EIS supplies the fixed diagnostic intervention, and OPERADS guarantees the same input/output skeleton and visibility policy in every arm. Each run executes only its assigned arm.
mathematical_basis.estimand: For fixed-seed expected final rubric score mu_ab under A=a,B=b, define Delta=mu_11-mu_10-mu_01+mu_00. With Y=beta0+betaA*A+betaB*B+betaAB*A*B+error and 0/1 coding, betaAB=Delta. Positive individual gains do not imply Delta>0. Report all four cell means, marginal contrasts and Delta; do not claim every named subsystem contributes from mu_11 alone.
mathematical_basis.design: Use equal allocation within preregistered time/model blocks, fresh provider samples, fixed N per cell, no arm selection from private outcomes, and intention-to-treat inclusion of refusals/truncations/timeouts. Endpoint/settings and total output allowance are equal across arms. Actual input/cost differences remain measured; equal-token and equal-money comparisons are distinct preregistered analyses, not assumed identical.
mathematical_basis.finite_uncertainty: For independent bounded scores Y in [0,100] and N samples per cell, Hoeffding plus a union bound gives simultaneous mean radius epsilon=100*sqrt(log(8/alpha)/(2*N)). Then Delta is within plus/minus 4*epsilon of the plug-in contrast with confidence at least 1-alpha under those assumptions. This deliberately conservative bound can be inconclusive; no invented small-N significance or cross-problem generalization. Blocking/randomization may justify a tighter preregistered randomization analysis.
mathematical_basis.distinct_from_prior: R04-I03 studies operation order; R09-I01 randomizes repair versus re-derivation; R03-I01 compares sibling wrappers. This experiment isolates the interaction of two independently toggled mechanisms at a fixed order and fixed call count. A hybrid win with zero or negative Delta is reported as additive benefit or interference, not synergy.
mathematical_basis.external_signature: Single assigned run: (RunContext, FactorialAssignment, FrozenFactorialProtocol, CalibratedPublicCheckerBundle) -> OutcomeWithArmReceipt. Analysis: (FrozenOutcomes, PostFreezeTrustedScores, FactorialProtocol) -> InteractionReport. The analysis is a separate offline campaign operator, not RunContext -> Outcome and not eligible for blind solver composition.
mathematical_basis.composition_constraint: No four-arm branch executes inside a run. Four isolated invocations form a campaign block, each with its own complete-run cap and an aggregate campaign ledger. Private scores enter only the terminal offline analysis, which has no edge back to wrappers, selection or either model call.

assumptions: All four configurations are semantically the same full unchanged seed task; disabling A removes optional artifact structure, never requested mathematical content or task assumptions.
The same public checker definitions apply wherever an arm has a parseable artifact; missing machine-readable claims remain unavailable rather than being counted correct.
Factor B's off arm still performs the same bounded generic revision and final public measurement; it simply receives no candidate-specific detector guidance before revision.
Assignments and sample sizes are frozen before results. Repetitions estimate provider variability on one item; shared model/parser biases remain possible in every cell.
ideas.hypothesis: The joint mechanism has Delta at least +3 rubric points and mu_11 is no more than 2 points below the best single-mechanism arm, while every assigned run respects USD0.10 and two calls. Claim synergy only if the preregistered interval supports the +3 threshold; otherwise report inconclusive or antagonistic interaction.

stages.instruction: Verify the precommitted arm and external checker provenance. Reserve just this run's two calls under its cap and the already-authorized aggregate campaign budget. Preserve the exact seed and fixed graph shape.

Receive the unchanged seed and exactly the assigned A wrapper. A=1 requests premise/dependency artifact context; A=0 requests the same full derivation with ordinary section labels. Both have identical output ceilings.

Run fixed public checks without private scoring. B=1 exposes only calibrated, scope-labelled public diagnostic classes; B=0 supplies the fixed generic revision instruction. Bind diagnostics to the draft hash. Do not adapt the selected arm or spend ceiling.

Receive the unchanged seed, draft and assigned revision view. Return a complete revised answer under the same 1600-token ceiling in all arms, with explicit unresolved parts if needed. No additional judge or synthesis call.

Run the same final public measurements and freeze the revised answer, or an explicit failure when no usable revision exists, with both raw artifacts retained. Later trusted scores belong only to offline analysis. No best-arm selection or prompt update occurs within this protocol.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: A=0,B=0 is the same-model two-call draft plus generic revision baseline. A=1,B=0 and A=0,B=1 identify the single-mechanism controls; A=1,B=1 is the hybrid.
ablations: Remove candidate binding from diagnostics only in public fault controls
Replace calibrated diagnostics with length-matched generic guidance in a separately budgeted follow-up, not an unregistered fifth primary arm
Compare raw draft and final response offline to locate repair-induced harm without choosing between them online
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: The campaign has four cells, not one eight-call run. Record every raw score/cost and all failures before aggregation. Report common failure clusters across all cells to expose shared-semantic/parser errors. Freeze one primary interaction contrast and uncertainty method; additional contrasts are labelled exploratory. No score-driven PCIV promotion until a separately preregistered fresh confirmation experiment.

ideas.falsification: If the interaction interval excludes +3 from above, the specified synergy hypothesis fails; an interval spanning the threshold is inconclusive. Unequal call counts, answer-key-dependent assignment, hidden arm-specific retries or dropping failed runs invalidate the comparison. A positive Delta cannot certify the checker or imply transfer beyond this item.
risks: Short revised-answer caps may create arm-specific truncation; that is an observed failure, not permission to silently expand one arm.
Typed contexts consume prompt/output space, so equal ceilings estimate the complete mechanism package rather than an isolated zero-cost mathematical effect.
A common faulty parser or shared model misconception can make all arms agree while remaining wrong.
Four-arm replication can require substantial aggregate spend despite small per-run costs; no campaign has been authorized or launched here.
ideas.budget_formula: Each assigned run makes exactly two planned calls and zero retries: I_total<=14000; O_total<=4400 (2800+1600). Conditional reserve USD0.046 per complete run. A four-cell block reserves up to USD0.184 at these thresholds, or USD0.40 at the absolute per-run caps, and needs separate aggregate authorization. Offline analysis uses no paid model calls.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: VisibilityAndContextBoundaryV1
recommended_reusable_primitive.recommendation: Start with a host-owned packet/view contract separating immutable task context, model-visible public artifacts, host-only artifacts and offline private evaluation. Validate it on synthetic compositions before any benchmark call.
recommended_reusable_primitive.invariant: A composition cannot erase an origin, turn an audit premise deletion into a task change, grant a blind stage candidate access, or create external calibration/campaign authority from a solver Outcome. Each explicitly declassified field requires a separately frozen allowlist rule; private evaluation is never declassified to the workflow.
recommended_reusable_primitive.research_prompt_instruction: Implement only generic host-boundary contracts and public synthetic controls. Do not read or solve the frozen seed, include seed-specific answers, consult private storage, or launch paid calls. Preserve exact seed bytes when a later authorized broker injects them.
recommended_reusable_primitive.first_experiment: Host-only synthetic noninterference and premise-replay tests, then a separately authorized fixed-arm pilot. The factorial campaign is a later independently budgeted experiment; no experiments or paid calls were executed in this report.
